fact: In December 2025 the Lesotho National Single Window was reported fully rolled out to all involved government agencies, with phase 2 (November 2024 to December 2025) adding 10 agencies and online payment expected in Q1 2026.
title: Lesotho Completes Full Rollout of the National Single Window, Marking a Major Milestone in Trade Facilitation Reform
